source_request:
요청자 입장에서 요청 내용의 키워드의 우선순위를 매기자면

1. 미소녀
2. 쿨데레
3. 반로환동
4. 북해빙궁

이 순서야. 그 점에서 스킬 사용을 통해 작성한 프롬프트와 이미지가 비교적 더 의도에 가깝긴 했어.
다만 아쉬운 건 첨부한 인물 이미지의 구도와 표정을 그대로 사용한 느낌이라 쿨데레한 미소녀를 의도해서 만든 건지 그냥 인물 이미지의 효과를 그대로 받았을 뿐인지는 잘 모르겠어. 그리고 그려진 이미지가 마망 컨셉과 크게 다르지 않아 보이기도 한다는 점에서 우선순위에서 밀리더라도 북해빙궁의 세계관(검이라던가, 빙공이라던가, 무공이라던가, 또는 빙벽이라던가 뭐 그런 거)을 약간은 더 표현하려고 했어도 좋았겠다 싶기는 해. 이를 위해서는 프롬프트 길이가 약간은 더 길어져도 괜찮다고 봐. 약간은 더 요청자의 의도를 담아 화보를 찍는 작가로서의 터치가 들어가면 어떨까 싶어. 이 점을 참고하여 이번엔 독립된 서브에이전트 환경에서 다시 한번 스킬을 사용해서 이미지를 생성해보고 평가해줘.
interpreted_intent: A luxury wuxia fashion editorial led first by the beauty of an unmistakably adult young woman, then by a deliberately authored cool-versus-selective-warmth response toward an adult peer, with rejuvenated ancient authority and Northern Sea Ice Palace martial worldbuilding as supporting layers.
subject: An unmistakably adult beautiful woman in her mid-twenties using only the attached portrait's facial appearance, with a newly authored swordmaster hairstyle, pose, composition, and expression.
setting: A frost-carved sword terrace inside the Northern Sea Ice Palace, edged by a translucent ice wall, embedded practice blades, and visible ice qi.
event: At measured peer distance, she uses a narrow ribbon of ice qi to return her trusted adult companion's dropped sword hilt-first, and only her eyes soften as his hand receives it.
visual_priorities: Beauty and charming adult facial presence remain the dominant focal hierarchy.
Cool restraint and one localized involuntary eye-softening read as a deliberate peer-specific response rather than inherited posing.
Youthful adult form contrasts with weathered sect-master objects and centuries of authority.
Sword, ice qi, martial footwork, and ice-wall details support the character without overtaking her.
Standing three-quarter fashion composition and expression are independently authored from the face reference.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a luxury wuxia fashion editorial of an unmistakably adult woman in her mid-twenties, beautiful and softly charming. She is a youthful adult form carrying the authority of centuries, restored master of a northern ice sect. Use the attached portrait solely as facial casting: preserve pale skin, tapered oval face, adult-scale cool-gray eyes, slim nose, full pale-rose lips, and the nose-side beauty mark. Restyle her ash-blonde hair into a high swordmaster half-up arrangement with airy bangs. Stage a newly authored standing three-quarter composition, body crossing the frame, head angled away from the lens, expression designed for this scene. On a frost-carved sword terrace inside the Northern Sea Ice Palace, she holds a calm, low-expression face and an upright, economical sword stance. Her trusted adult peer's dropped sword lies across the frozen floor. Maintaining measured arm's-length distance, she guides the same trusted adult peer's dropped sword hilt-first toward his open hand with one narrow ribbon of ice qi. As the hilt reaches the same trusted adult peer, only her lower eyelids soften as her eyes flick briefly toward him. His surprised fingers begin to close around the returning hilt; the sword reaches his hand while paired split-jade tassels glow across the small gap. The paired split-jade tassels identify the same adult peer and her own matching sword. Equal-height paired swords and measured spacing frame them as adult peers. Keep her the dominant beauty focal point; show the companion as a clearly adult partial profile and hand at the right edge. A weathered sect-master jade seal and ancient ice sword imply old authority. A translucent ice wall with embedded practice blades and spiraling frost from her footwork reveal martial power. Use a vertical medium-wide 50mm frame, winter moonlight, pale-jade rim light, airborne ice dust, tactile silk and steel, realistic skin and hands, and a poised luxury-editorial finish.

interpretation_provenance.resolution: Allocate visual hierarchy in exactly this order: adult beauty first, restrained selective warmth second, rejuvenated ancient authority third, and ice-palace worldbuilding fourth.
